user.title: Connect Grok
user.description: Use the public HTTPS address of your Home Assistant (Nabu Casa remote access or your own domain, optionally with a port). This connector has independent permissions and credentials.

error.invalid_url: Enter only an HTTPS origin with a hostname and optional port, without credentials, a path, query or fragment.
error.invalid_action: Enter a name, an optional description and a valid nonempty Home Assistant action sequence.

pair.title: Pairing code
pair.description:
MCP URL for your custom Grok connector:

{mcp_url}

One-time pairing code:

**{pairing_secret}**

Valid for 10 minutes. Enter it in the authorization window opened by Grok. Creating another code invalidates the previous unused code.

revoke.title: Revoke Grok access
revoke.description: Confirm to invalidate all access tokens, refresh tokens and pending pairing for this connector. A new connection needs a new pairing code.

error.invalid_action: Enter a name, an optional description and a valid nonempty Home Assistant action sequence.

abort.not_loaded: The connector is not running. Enable it and try again.
abort.too_many_actions: At most 64 actions may be exposed.
